title: China transformer panel radiators
subtitle: Sales-volume share | 110 kV-and-above transformer applications | 2025
market_definition: Plate-type radiators for transformers rated 110 kV and above.
metric: Estimated market share by sales volume

segments.label: Youbang Radiator
segments.value_type: Association estimate reproduced in issuer/sponsor regulatory disclosure

precision: Two decimal places as disclosed; no additional precision inferred.

source.institution: Youbang Radiator (Changshu) Co., Ltd. and China Securities Co., Ltd.; published by Beijing Stock Exchange
source.title: Response to the IPO application review inquiry for Youbang Radiator (Changshu) Co., Ltd.
source.locator: Printed p58; one-based PDF page59; zero-based PDF index58

evidence_method: The Transformer Branch of the China Electrical Equipment Industry Association surveyed sales volumes of major domestic radiator-producing member firms, then extrapolated nationally. The issuer/sponsor filing reproduces the association estimate; it is primary evidence of the disclosure, not a census of the whole market.
exclusions: Products below 110 kV and other transformer cooling systems are outside the market definition. This chart does not describe all transformers or all grid equipment.
limitations: Raw survey data, sample coverage, numerical numerator/denominator and extrapolation formula were not disclosed.
The physical sales-volume unit was not specified.
Financial consolidation entities and elimination of related-party/internal sales were not specified for the share numerator.
Other manufacturers is a calculated residual, not separately observed data; no individual competitor share or total market volume was disclosed.
footnotes: Source [M09]: issuer/sponsor BSE reply, disclosed 2 July 2026, printed p58. China domestic market, 2025.
Industry-association survey of major member manufacturers, extrapolated nationally; estimate, not a census.
Other manufacturers = 100 - 14.72 = 85.28%. Source precision retained; residual inherits estimate uncertainty.
Physical volume unit, sample coverage and consolidation/related-party exclusions were not disclosed.
rights: Chart is an original visualization of disclosed figures; source PDF/page screenshots are not reproduced.
alt_text: Donut chart of estimated 2025 sales-volume share in China's market for plate radiators used on transformers rated 110 kV and above. Youbang Radiator: 14.72%; other manufacturers: 85.28%, calculated as the residual. This narrow component market is not the total grid-equipment market. The data is an association survey and national extrapolation reproduced in a BSE filing.
